title: chrono::parse_from_rfc2822 replaces fragile strip-day-of-week heuristic
description: parse_from_rfc2822 handles the full RFC 2822 date grammar including optional day-of-week prefix natively. The old code stripped the prefix with find(',') which would corrupt dates in the rare case a date has no day-of-week but has a comma elsewhere. The replacement is shorter, more correct, and the right amount of code.
